verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a public API with an API reference, generated API keys with roles, and programmatic incident creation. It also offers a public status-page JSON API and an official MCP server that exposes incident data and actions such as querying incidents, checking on-call schedules, and taking action. Nothing shows the API covers everything the UI can do, and a probe found no OpenAPI spec at the common paths, so coverage cannot be verified. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for schedules, escalation policies, alert routes, workflows, retrospectives and status-page management; an explicit UI/API parity statement; a discoverable OpenAPI spec; independent hands-on corroboration.
